STRING protein-protein interaction network

Source: R/plot_network.R
plot_network.Rd

Maps a set of protein/assay identifiers to the STRING database and downloads a protein-protein interaction network image via the `rbioapi` package. Requires an internet connection.

Usage

plot_network(
  assays,
  assay_col = NULL,
  species = 9606,
  required_score = 500,
  network_flavor = "confidence",
  add_white_nodes = 5,
  image_format = "image",
  outdir = tempdir(),
  ...
)

Arguments

assays

Character vector of protein identifiers (e.g. gene symbols or UniProt IDs). If a data.frame is supplied, `assay_col` is used to extract them.

assay_col

Name of the assay/protein column when `assays` is a data.frame. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

species

NCBI taxonomy ID (default 9606, Homo sapiens).

required_score

Confidence score threshold (0-1000, default 500).

network_flavor

STRING network flavor: "confidence", "actions", "evidence", "interactive" (default "confidence").

add_white_nodes

Number of white (neighborhood) nodes to add.

image_format

Image format: "image" (PNG) or "highres_image" (default "image").

outdir

Directory to save the downloaded image (default tempdir()).

...

Additional arguments passed to `rbioapi::rba_string_network_image()`.

Value

Invisibly returns the path to the downloaded image.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_network(c("IL6", "TNF", "CXCL10", "CD40", "IL10"))
} # }
